text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the race, a reporter asks Mr. C.B. 
about her ambitions regarding the Classic 
Triple Crown route. But her answer—that 
her path is yet undecided—sends a ripple 
of shock through the venue.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Katsuragi Ace barges in, issuing a 
challenge to settle things at the Satsuki 
Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Reporters raised doubts, saying Katsuragi 
Ace wasn't on the right level. However, 
she boldly declared she would prove them 
wrong.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing that, Mr. C.B.'s heart thrilled 
with excitement. She declared she would 
take the Classic Triple Crown route to 
fight Katsuragi Ace. —Her next goal was 
the Satsuki Sho.
